restoration: For each moved-recorders.json path, verify the symlink target, unlink only the symlink, and rename archive/recorders/<path> to the original path. Restore caches from disposable-caches.tar.gz if needed. Exact symlink ignores are local in .git/info/exclude; its pre-cleanup bytes are archived.
note: Recorder relocation reduces physical project contents, not total disk usage. Existing paths resolve through local absolute symlinks. Archive must be retained with this checkout.
